为什么值得看 这项工作直接触及可控世界模型的训练、长时程推理与部署：它把双向动作条件教师蒸馏为因果学生，并用长时程教师约束自回滚，从而针对分布偏移和自回归漂移改善闭环交互；同时给出单张桌面显卡上的实时部署路径，适合关注游戏代理、具身模拟和世界模型推理效率的研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 196）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

动作条件视频模型需要同时保持可控性、长时程一致性和实时闭环交互能力。

02
方法

系统结合世界探索器、多源数据清洗与标注、双向教师到因果学生的蒸馏，以及长时程强制训练。

03
差异

它用扩展时域教师约束学生自回滚，并以原始键盘动作和参考角色记忆统一控制与身份保持。

04
证据

在世界漫游基准和扩展交互回滚中，作者报告了有竞争力的可控性与连贯的长时程世界演化，并实现单张显卡每秒最高十六帧的七百二十点流式输出。

摘要

我们提出阿博特世界零号，这是一种动作条件视频世界模型，面向实时、长时程闭环交互，并利用涵盖大型游戏、仿真引擎和互联网视频的多源数据基础设施学习可控世界动力学。系统通过世界探索器、十四项确定性质量检查、视觉语言模型评估、动作与文本同步标注，以及将双向动作条件教师经教师强制和常微分方程蒸馏为因果学生的训练流程，结合长时程强制来减轻累积分布偏移和自回归漂移；在部署时，它借助轻量变分自编码器解码器、高效注意力、感知内存的调度和低比特扩散变换器推理，在单张英伟达锐龙五零九零显卡上以最高每秒十六帧流式生成七百二十点视频，动作到首帧延迟为一点二秒，峰值显存约十九吉字节。

为什么值得看 这项工作把扩散变换器中的语义维护从输入提示词转向了生成过程中的因果机制：结构模板词虽然起点几乎不含提示信息，却会吸收图像潜变量中的对象身份并作为注意力汇保存它。由此得到的免训练剪枝规则可移除百分之二十的注意力浮点运算，而生成评测仅下降一点四分，适合关注扩散模型可解释性、推理加速和结构化剪枝的研究者。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 68）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

研究文本内容词和结构模板词在扩散变换器去噪过程中分别承担什么作用。

02
方法

使用注意力分解以及对词元跨度、注意力头和网络层的定向干预进行因果分析，并据此筛选可剪枝的注意力头。

03
差异

分析重点从输入端携带语义的词元转向生成过程中间接获得并维持对象身份的结构模板词。

04
证据

作者报告剪除最关注提示词的注意力头可减少百分之二十的注意力浮点运算，同时生成评测仅下降一点四分。

摘要

文本到图像的扩散变换器共同处理文本词元和图像词元，但其去噪过程中的内部计算仍缺乏清晰解释。作者通过结合注意力分解与针对词元跨度、注意力头和层的干预，发现结构模板词在编码器输出中几乎不含提示特定信息，却会成为图像到文本注意力的主要汇点，并因果地维持对象身份；基于此，作者提出免训练的剪枝规则，可减少百分之二十的注意力浮点运算，而生成评测仅下降一点四分。

为什么值得看 这项工作把视觉生成的主要效率瓶颈放到分词器、扩散主干和系统实现的联合设计上，而不只是缩小模型；对需要高分辨率、低延迟生成或编辑的研究者，它提供了从潜变量编码成本、原生分辨率训练到少步推理的一套可复用路线。摘要称分词成本降低一个数量级以上、端到端训练吞吐提升约二点五倍，并在单张英伟达A100上将一千零二十四平方分辨率生成和编辑压到零点五九秒与一点零二秒。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 58）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

大规模视觉生成模型的训练、微调、部署和高分辨率推理成本较高。

02
方法

系统使用带锚点潜变量正则化的一步扩散式编码解码器、原生分辨率多模态扩散变换器、整流流匹配和四步蒸馏。

03
差异

它同时改造潜变量分词器、生成主干和计算内核，并以原生分辨率打包替代仅依赖缩小模型或低分辨率处理。

04
证据

摘要报告分词成本降低一个数量级以上、训练吞吐提升约二点五倍，并给出快速版在单张英伟达A100上的生成与编辑延迟。

摘要

文章介绍了一个四十亿参数级的高效生成系统，用于文本生成图像和基于指令的图像编辑。系统由轻量高保真潜变量分词器与采用整流流匹配训练的原生分辨率多模态扩散变换器共同构成，并结合强化学习对齐、蒸馏和对抗性感知引导，形成基础版、对齐版和四步快速版模型；摘要称其在标准生成与编辑基准上具有竞争力，快速版可在单张英伟达A100上以较小显存实现高分辨率交互式生成与编辑。

为什么值得看 该工作把视频扩散模型推进到可交互、长时段世界生成：它同时处理相机控制、空间时间记忆、长期漂移和推理速度，并将每个片段的采样步数从约三十步降到四步，适合关注世界模型、视频生成和实时交互的研究者。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 48）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

交互式视频世界模型需要同时维持可控交互、持久的空间时间一致性、稳定的长时段生成和高效响应。

02
方法

方法使用一百五十亿参数的视频扩散变换器自回归生成短潜变量片段，并融合多种视觉记忆与自回归蒸馏。

03
差异

它用受损历史和自身 rollout 残差训练模型抑制漂移，并把分布匹配、自强制增强和一致性蒸馏结合起来。

04
证据

系统以每秒二十四帧生成五百四十像素和七百二十像素视频，将每片段采样降至四步，并在长时段基准上取得最佳表现。

摘要

阿拉雅世界是一种交互式长时段视频世界模型，能够根据用户输入生成每秒二十四帧、五百四十像素和七百二十像素分辨率的视频环境。它基于一百五十亿参数的视频扩散变换器，在相机轨迹和可切换文本提示的控制下自回归生成短潜变量片段，并结合持久锚定帧、压缩时间历史、几何对齐空间记忆和近期帧条件来维持一致性；模型还通过自身 rollout 收集的受损历史与预测残差减少长期漂移，并利用离散自回归蒸馏将每个片段的推理从约三十个采样步骤降至四步。在长时段生成基准上，该模型取得了最佳表现。

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对异步强化学习中的策略滞后与推理训练不一致问题，把按样本计算的滞后程度转化为信赖域约束：普通样本保持近端策略优化的行为，只收紧高滞后样本的外向更新。在基于三百亿参数混合专家模型的异步实验中，该方法在滞后为一和八时分别取得三十五点八三和三十四点七九的数学评测平均准确率，适合关注大规模异步强化学习稳定性的研究者。

来源信号Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 30）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

异步强化学习中的策略滞后、引擎延迟和专家路由差异会使旧轨迹与当前策略严重不匹配。

02
方法

方法使用脱离梯度的采样对数比率作为滞后代理，按滞后程度缩放核函数，并收缩近端策略区间的符号选定端点。

03
差异

它不是统一收紧所有样本，而是保留普通样本的基线更新并针对高不匹配尾部加强约束。

04
证据

理论给出局部区间包含与逐点悲观性，实验在滞后为一和八时分别报告三十五点八三和三十四点七九的数学评测平均准确率。

摘要

异步强化学习通过解耦轨迹生成与优化来提高吞吐量，但策略滞后、引擎延迟和混合专家路由会共同造成不可避免的陈旧性。从信赖域角度看，这种不匹配会影响有限时域界中的近似误差，而近端策略优化的裁剪只限制采样到的外向更新，并不是完整策略约束，因此在陈旧轨迹最重要的异步场景中控制仍然不足。本文提出陈旧性自适应信赖域，利用脱离梯度的采样对数比率估计陈旧程度，在批次内识别高不匹配尾部，并只收缩名义近端策略区间中由符号选定的端点；理论上证明了区间包含关系和相对于近端策略优化的逐点悲观性，并在解耦异步强化学习实验中显示出稳定作用。

high · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 这项工作直接针对可验证奖励强化学习中的优化层，给出一种固定奇异值谱、只更新输入输出奇异向量的后训练方案。它既可在无额外数据、采样或梯度更新的情况下合并专长模型，也可让在线训练用更少步数达到相同效果；这对推理和代码模型的强化学习后训练尤其有用。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 5）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

可验证奖励强化学习中的权重更新机制尚不清楚，现有后训练优化未必适合奖励驱动的适应过程。

02
方法

方法固定基础模型的奇异值谱，只优化输入和输出奇异向量，并提供离线合并与在线优化两种实现。

03
差异

离线版本无需合并后数据、采样、梯度更新或在线蒸馏，在线版本则可将阿达姆沃或缪翁等优化器作用于奇异向量变量。

04
证据

在八十亿参数的基础模型上，固定谱的阿达姆沃在一百步达到普通阿达姆沃二百七十步的百分之四十九点五准确率，并在二百一十步达到百分之五十点九。

摘要

可验证奖励强化学习正在提升语言模型的推理能力，但如何将奖励反馈转化为权重更新的优化层仍缺乏理解。本文通过模型权重的奇异结构发现谱继承现象：模型可以复用基础模型的权重谱，同时通过改变相关的输入和输出奇异向量获得新行为；据此提出等谱优化，并分别实现离线合并和在线优化，在一至八十亿参数规模的推理与代码任务上报告了更高准确率或更少训练步数。

为什么值得看 这项工作把可验证结果奖励引入连续潜变量推理，绕开逐步语言解码和不可计算的逐步似然问题；它面向希望降低测试时推理成本、同时保留强化学习扩展能力的潜变量推理模型。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 2）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

潜变量轨迹缺少可处理的逐步似然和固定思考预算下的自适应停止接口，因此结果奖励难以推动其测试时扩展。

02
方法

方法使用潜变量转移的经验替代策略密度进行轨迹级信用分配，并以正确性监督的停止头优化可变时长策略。

03
差异

它将结果奖励强化学习从显式语言思维链迁移到自回归潜变量推理，而不是继续依赖模仿学习。

04
证据

在连续思考和软思考设置中，方法提升了并行采样的通过率，并把更长的潜变量计算分配给更难样本且提高确定性准确率。

摘要

带可验证奖励的强化学习已成为显式思维链推理器实现测试时扩展的主要方法，但每个中间步骤都必须解码为语言标记，计算成本较高。潜变量推理以连续向量承载中间计算，在更短轨迹上已达到或超过显式思维链，却长期受限于模仿学习；该方法通过潜变量转移的经验替代策略密度进行轨迹级信用分配，并利用正确性监督的停止头实现可变时长推理，从而在连续思考和软思考设置下提升并行采样的通过率，并让更难样本获得更长的潜变量计算。

为什么值得看 这项工作为视觉语言模型的可验证奖励强化学习提供了可复现的数据生成环境，解决了任务覆盖面、答案可验证性和训练实例重放难以同时满足的问题。其跨二十四个外部基准的提升表明，程序化生成的多领域视觉推理任务可能比单一数据集更适合训练可迁移的推理能力。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 3）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

视觉语言模型缺少覆盖多领域且答案能够精确验证和重复生成的强化学习训练数据。

02
方法

方法用场景语法生成视觉内容，用可执行任务程序计算答案，并由共享语义状态驱动渲染、提示、验证和轨迹重放。

03
差异

任务构造把视觉实现与答案计算分离，并以分类体系组织一千个任务、二百七十七种场景语法和十一个视觉领域。

04
证据

ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU

CategoryAreaModels and Training Methods / Architecture DesignTopicdiffusion / generative modeling
Fan Jiang, Zhaoxu Sun, Mengchao Wang, Ziyu Zhu, Chiyu Wang, Yunpeng Zhang et al.
high · 2026-07-21

Why it matters This work targets controllable world-model training, long-horizon inference, and practical deployment: it distills a bidirectional action-conditioned teacher into a causal student and uses long-horizon teacher supervision to address rollout distribution shift and autoregressive drift. Its single-desktop-GPU operating point also gives researchers in game agents, embodied simulation, and world-model efficiency a concrete systems reference.

Source signalsarXiv indexedHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 196)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Action-conditioned video models must preserve control, long-horizon consistency, and real-time closed-loop interaction at once.

02
Method

The system combines agent-guided data collection, multi-source filtering and annotation, bidirectional-teacher-to-causal-student distillation, and LongForcing training.

03

Abstract

We present ABot-World-0, an action-conditioned video world model for real-time, long-horizon closed-loop interaction, supported by a multi-source data infrastructure spanning AAA games, simulation engines, and internet videos to learn controllable world dynamics. WorldExplorer performs agent-driven collection guided by training feedback, while a unified pipeline applies 14 deterministic quality checks, VLM-based assessment, and synchronized action and text annotation. We progressively distill a bidirectional action-conditioned teacher into a causal student through teacher forcing and ODE distillation, and introduce LongForcing to align long student self-rollouts with an extended-horizon teacher, mitigating accumulated distribution shift and autoregressive drift. Raw keyboard actions provide a unified control interface for scene roaming and third-person character interaction, while reference-character memory provides persistent appearance cues for identity consistency during third-person rollouts. For deployment, we co-design a streaming inference stack with a lightweight VAE decoder, efficient attention, memory-aware scheduling, and low-bit DiT inference. Across optimized low-bit configurations, ABot-World-0 streams 720P video at up to 16 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 desktop GPU, with 1.2s action-to-first-frame latency and approximately 19GiB peak VRAM. Experiments on WorldRoamBench and extended interactive rollouts demonstrate competitive controllability and coherent long-horizon world evolution.

Text Template Tokens Are Implicit Semantic Registers in Diffusion Transformers

CategoryAreaModels and Training Methods / Architecture DesignTopicdiffusion / generative modeling
Maohua Li, Qirui Li, Yanke Zhou, Yiduo Li, Zhaosheng Chi, Chao Xu et al.
high · 2026-07-21

Why it matters This work shifts the explanation of semantic maintenance in diffusion transformers from prompt tokens to the denoising computation itself: structural template tokens start with little prompt information, then read object identity back from image latents and preserve it as attention sinks. The resulting training-free pruning rule removes 20% of attention FLOPs with only a 1.4-point GenEval drop, making the paper relevant to researchers studying diffusion interpretability, inference efficiency, and structured pruning.

Source signalsarXiv indexedHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 68)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

The paper studies what prompt-content and structural template tokens do during denoising in diffusion transformers.

02
Method

It combines attention decomposition with targeted interventions over token spans, heads, and layers, then uses the findings to identify prunable heads.

03
Difference

It focuses on structural template tokens that acquire and maintain object identity during generation rather than assuming that input semantic tokens carry it throughout the network.

04
Evidence

The authors report a 20% reduction in attention FLOPs with only a 1.4-point GenEval decrease after pruning heads that attend most strongly to prompt tokens.

Abstract

Text-to-image diffusion transformers (DiTs) jointly process text and image tokens, yet their internal computation during denoising remains poorly understood. We introduce a causal interpretability framework for modern large-scale DiTs that combines attention decomposition with targeted interventions across token spans, heads, and layers. Using it to separate prompt-content tokens from structural template tokens, we find that the structural tokens carry little prompt-specific information at the encoder output. Yet surprisingly, they emerge as dominant image-to-text attention sinks and causally maintain object identity inside the DiT, acting as implicit semantic registers. We show that they acquire this identity indirectly, with prompt semantics first injected into the image latents and then read back into the template tokens rather than transferred directly from the prompt tokens. Inspired by the above findings, we design a training-free pruning rule for DiTs. Heads that attend most strongly to prompt tokens are dispensable, and pruning them removes $20\%$ of attention FLOPs with only a $1.4$-point drop on GenEval. We further reveal how generative computation in DiTs is organized across heads and depth, separating semantic routing from visual synthesis and progressing from identity formation to propagation and refinement. Our work not only reveals that the tokens encoding semantics at input need not be those that maintain it during generation, but also provides a causal view of internal mechanisms in DiTs.

Abstract

Large-scale visual generators are increasingly capable but costly to train, fine-tune, and deploy. We introduce Mage-Flow, a compact 4B-scale generative stack for efficient text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing. The stack is built from two co-designed components: Mage-VAE, a lightweight high-fidelity latent tokenizer, and a Native-Resolution Multimodal Diffusion Transformer trained with rectified flow matching. Mage-VAE uses one-step diffusion-style encoding and decoding with anchor-latent regularization, preserving the reconstruction quality of strong public VAEs while reducing tokenization cost by more than an order of magnitude. Together with native-resolution packing and stack-level CUDA kernel fusion, the stack supports flexible-resolution training and improves end-to-end training throughput by about $2.5\times$. Built on this foundation, we develop a complete model family with Base, RL-aligned, and Turbo variants for both generation and editing. Diffusion-NFT improves prompt following, text rendering, aesthetic quality, and editing fidelity, while few-step distillation with adversarial perceptual guidance produces 4-step Turbo models for low-latency inference. Despite its compact scale, Mage-Flow and Mage-Flow-Edit achieves competitive performance across standard generation and editing benchmarks. More importantly, the Turbo variants make high-resolution generation and editing practical for interactive use: at $1024^2$ resolution on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, Mage-Flow-Turbo generates an image in 0.59s, and Mage-Flow-Edit-Turbo edits an image in 1.02s, while maintaining a small memory footprint. These results show that careful tokenizer--backbone--system co-design can deliver strong high-resolution generation and editing within an efficient 4B model family.

AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report

CategoryAreaModels and Training Methods / Architecture DesignTopicdiffusion / generative modeling

high · 2026-07-20

Why it matters This work pushes video diffusion toward interactive, long-horizon world generation by addressing camera control, persistent spatial-temporal memory, rollout drift, and response latency together. Method brief
01
Problem

Interactive video world models must maintain controllability, persistent spatial-temporal consistency, stable long-horizon generation, and efficient response.

02
Method

The system autoregressively generates short latent chunks with a 15B video diffusion transformer and combines bounded visual memory with discrete autoregressive distillation.

03

Abstract

Unlike conventional video game development, which relies on labor-intensive pipelines for asset production, animation, physics, and programming, video world models generate interactive environments from user inputs instantly. It enable us to create customized, explorable, and continuously evolving virtual world from text, an image, or video. Realizing this vision requires four tightly coupled capabilities: interaction, persistent spatiotemporal consistency, stable long-horizon generation, and efficient response. We present AlayaWorld, an interactive long-horizon video world model that generates 24-fps video at 540p and 720p. Built on a 15B video diffusion transformer, AlayaWorld generates short latent chunks autoregressively under camera trajectories and switchable text prompts. Its bounded visual context combines a persistent sink frame, compressed temporal history, geometry-aligned spatial memory, and recent-frame conditioning. To reduce long-term drift, the model is trained with corrupted histories and prediction residuals collected from its own roll-outs. We further introduce a discrete autoregressive distillation formulation that combines distribution-matching distillation, self-forcing++, and consistency distillation, reducing inference from approximately 30 sampling steps to four steps per chunk. On iWorld-Bench, AlayaWorld achieves the best performance over long-horizon generation. Conceived as a full-stack, open-source, and long-term project, AlayaWorld is intended to provide an extensible foundation for future research on interactive video world models.

Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Stabilizing Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning

CategoryAreaReasoning, Agents, and Post-Training / Post-Training and AlignmentTopicreinforcement learning

high · 2026-07-21

Why it matters This paper targets policy lag and training-inference mismatch in asynchronous RL by turning per-sample staleness into a trust-region constraint: ordinary samples retain PPO-like behavior, while high-staleness samples receive tighter outward-update control. In an asynchronous setup with a 30B mixture-of-experts model, it reports AIME24 avg@8 scores of 35.83 at lag 1 and 34.79 at lag 8, making it relevant to researchers scaling asynchronous RL.

Source signalsHugging Face Daily Papers (community upvotes 👍 30)
Code
Method brief
01
Problem

Asynchronous RL suffers mismatch between stale rollouts and the current policy because of policy lag, engine delays, and routing differences.

02
Method

SAT uses a detached sampled log-ratio as a staleness proxy, scales a kernel by staleness, and contracts the sign-selected endpoint of the nominal PPO interval.

03
Difference

Instead of tightening every sample uniformly, it preserves baseline updates for ordinary samples and adds restrictions only to high-mismatch tails.

04

Abstract

Asynchronous reinforcement learning improves throughput by decoupling rollout generation from optimization, but staleness is an inevitable byproduct compounded by policy lag, engine delays, and mixture-of-experts routing. From a trust-region perspective, this mismatch is critical: training-inference divergence governs approximation error in finite-horizon bounds, whereas PPO clipping only gates sampled outward updates, acting as a sampled surrogate rather than a full-policy constraint. As a result, high-staleness updates remain weakly controlled in the asynchronous regime where stale rollouts matter most. We introduce the Staleness-Adaptive Trust Region (SAT), which uses the detached sampled log-ratio as a practical staleness proxy, identifies high-mismatch tails within each batch via staleness-based kernel scaling, and contracts only the sign-selected endpoint of the nominal PPO interval. This preserves baseline behavior on ordinary tokens while enforcing more conservative updates on newly intercepted outward bands. We prove local interval containment and pointwise pessimism relative to PPO, showing how the adaptive rule reshapes update geometry under heterogeneous staleness. We evaluate SAT in a decoupled asynchronous RL setup built on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, using SGLang as the inference engine and Megatron for training. In this setting, SAT-GSPO w/ R3 achieves the best observed AIME24 avg@8, reaching 35.83 at lag 1 and 34.79 at lag 8, while SAT-GSPO reaches 34.17 at lag 1. Adaptive clipping and routing replay act as complementary stabilizers targeting mismatch tails and routing inconsistency, respectively. Overall, aligning clip intervals with staleness heterogeneity effectively stabilizes asynchronous RL.

ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU

分类方向编译器、内核与硬件 / GPU/加速器内核主题accelerator / edge inference
Fan Jiang, Zhaoxu Sun, Mengchao Wang, Ziyu Zhu, Chiyu Wang, Yunpeng Zhang et al.
medium · 2026-07-21

为什么值得看 这项工作对单卡实时视频生成服务有直接参考价值：它把轻量变分自编码器、注意力优化、内存感知调度和低比特扩散变换器推理联合到流式部署栈中，在单张桌面显卡上实现七百二十高清画面、每秒最多十六帧和约一点九万亿字节峰值显存。对关注交互式世界模型、视频推理延迟和显存受限部署的研究者，它提供了比离线生成更接近真实服务约束的系统设计案例。

来源信号arXiv 收录Hugging Face Daily Papers（社区点赞 👍 196）
代码
方法解读
01
问题

系统要在长时域闭环交互中同时保持动作可控、世界演化连贯和实时视频输出。

02
方法

工作构建多源数据管线，并将双向动作条件教师通过教师强制和常微分方程蒸馏转为因果学生模型。

03
差异

长程强制让学生自主展开对齐扩展时域教师模型，同时部署栈联合使用轻量解码、高效注意力、内存感知调度和低比特推理。

04
证据

单张英伟达五零九零显卡上达到每秒最多十六帧、动作到首帧一点二秒和约十九吉比字节峰值显存，并在世界漫游基准及扩展展开中进行评测。

摘要

本文介绍了阿博特世界零号，这是一个支持实时、长时域闭环交互的动作条件视频世界模型，并通过涵盖大型商业游戏、仿真引擎和互联网视频的多源数据基础设施学习可控的世界动力学。系统使用世界探索器进行受训练反馈引导的智能体数据采集，采用十四项确定性质量检查、视觉语言模型评估以及同步的动作和文本标注；随后通过教师强制与常微分方程蒸馏，将双向动作条件教师模型逐步蒸馏为因果学生模型，并用长程强制使学生的长期自主展开对齐扩展时域教师模型，以减轻累积分布偏移和自回归漂移。原始键盘动作统一了场景漫游和第三人称角色交互的控制接口，参考角色记忆则维持第三人称展开中的外观和身份一致性。部署方面，系统联合设计了流式推理栈、轻量变分自编码器解码器、高效注意力、内存感知调度和低比特扩散变换器推理；在优化后的低比特配置下，它可在单张英伟达五零九零桌面显卡上以每秒最多十六帧流式生成七百二十高清画面，动作到首帧延迟为一点二秒，峰值显存约为十九吉比字节。世界漫游基准和扩展交互展开实验显示，该系统具有有竞争力的可控性和连贯的长时域世界演化。

To the best of our knowledge, PolySim is the first method to enable probabilistic cross-modal retrieval on CiM hardware.
